detail.longDescription: NEW: An Alarming Spike in Ectopic Pregnancy Deaths Was Hiding in Plain Sight in a Federal Dataset --- Our analysis of death certificate data kept by the federal government found ectopic pregnancy deaths have nearly doubled, and it’s worse in states with abortion bans. How could it be that seemingly no one was aware of this but us? https://www. propublica.org/article/ectopic -pregnancy-data-analysis?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=mastodon-post # News # Pregnancy # Women # Abortion # Data # Research # Health # Medicine
